transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I'm ready to review the broadcast plan for Saturday's festival charity gala. Before I can give final approval, I'll need to walk through the standard sign-off process — that includes a verbal check with engineering and clearance, and we'll need to confirm the licensing terms and any production changes on record. Let's start by going over the draft distribution plan and any production instructions so we can make sure everything is in order.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Morgan, during the engineering sign-off — I need to flag a production change. This morning's final radio-frequency scan found that the wireless podium microphone intermittently overlaps the venue's emergency-communications channel. The podium must use the tested wired microphone instead. I've recorded the scan in the engineering worksheet, but it hasn't been circulated to the production team yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Morgan, for the clearance sign-off — I confirmed with Northstar Archives this afternoon that the gala's licensed archival clip may be streamed live only to viewers in the United States, may not remain available as a replay, and requires the on-screen credit exactly 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives.' I have the licensor's email in the clearance inbox but haven't copied it into the broadcast plan yet. This directly conflicts with the draft distribution plan's worldwide stream and seven-day replay, so those need to be corrected before approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the broadcast plan to restrict the live stream to United States viewers only and remove the seven-day replay, replacing the draft worldwide stream and seven-day replay terms.
Replace the wireless podium microphone with the tested wired microphone per the engineering RF scan finding. Circulate the engineering worksheet to the production team.
Copy the Northstar Archives licensing terms and licensor email into the broadcast plan, including the on-screen credit requirement: 'Courtesy of Northstar Archives.'
